notch2-balanced.source: Cruz Tleugabulova et al., Nature Communications (2024), Figure 2b
notch2-balanced.provenance: Selected and reordered four embedded PDF legend colors (I2, I1, I4, M1). This selection spans cell classes within the same figure and is not an author-provided named palette.
notch2-balanced.note: User selected candidate B on the cell-atlas panel; review independently for other chart contexts.

notch2-blue.source: EasyViz interpolation from Cruz Tleugabulova et al. Figure 2b I2 blue
notch2-blue.adaptation: White mixed with #2581B9 at 20%,40%,60%,80%,100% endpoint weight in sRGB. The stronger light endpoint supports low-value borderless marks; it is not an author colormap.

somerville-bright.source: Somerville et al., Nature Communications (2024), Figures 1B and 2B
somerville-bright.provenance: Selected and reordered published PDF vector fills, rounded to 8-bit RGB. No claim of original author-script hex values.
somerville-bright.note: Prefer first four colors for compact groups; gold and turquoise need larger marks, outlines or direct labels.

notch2-bright.source: Cruz Tleugabulova et al., Nature Communications (2024), Figure 2b
notch2-bright.provenance: Exact RGB pixels from embedded PDF legend swatches, selected and reordered. Original author-script constants unknown.
notch2-bright.note: Amber and orange are closer; retain direct labels or other redundant distinctions.

somerville-sky.source: EasyViz interpolation from Somerville et al. Figure 2A culture-202 blue
somerville-sky.adaptation: Mix white with the observed #009CF0 endpoint at 4%,25%,50%,75%,100% endpoint weight in sRGB. This is an EasyViz scale, not an author colormap.

somerville-coral.source: EasyViz interpolation from Somerville et al. Figure 1B culture-105 coral
somerville-coral.adaptation: Mix white with observed #E47751 at 4%,25%,50%,75%,100% endpoint weight in sRGB; not an author colormap.

notch2-teal.source: EasyViz interpolation from Cruz Tleugabulova et al. Figure 2b I4 teal
notch2-teal.adaptation: Mix white with observed #1AA781 at 4%,25%,50%,75%,100% endpoint weight in sRGB; not an author colormap.

somerville-blue-coral.source: EasyViz interpolation from two categorical endpoints in Somerville et al. Figure 1B
somerville-blue-coral.adaptation: New blue-white-coral continuous scale. White/interpolation are EasyViz choices, not an observed author gradient.
somerville-blue-coral.note: Use only around an explicit scientifically meaningful midpoint; preserve scale and normalization when recoloring existing data.

okabe-ito.source: Masataka Okabe and Kei Ito, Color Universal Design
okabe-ito.note: Order arranged for white-background plots. Use outlines for yellow; no guarantee for every adjacent pair.

easyviz-muted.note: Legacy project-selected muted colors; explicit opt-in, not a preferred create default.

blue-white-red.note: Use a meaningful center, such as zero; colors are interpolated.

scwat-blue-coral.source: Huang et al., Nature Communications (2023), Figure 2
scwat-blue-coral.provenance: Selected group-colored PDF vector strokes/fills from inspected Figure 2; RGB rounded to 8-bit HEX. Author-script constants unknown. Reassignment to new group labels is a design decision.
scwat-blue-coral.note: Two colors only; no cycling. Inspect opaque observations, hollow edges and matching keys on the actual data.

scwat-blue-white-coral.source: EasyViz interpolation using Huang et al. Figure 2 categorical endpoints
scwat-blue-white-coral.adaptation: New continuous blue-white-coral ramp from two observed categorical colors. White and interpolation are EasyViz design decisions; this is not the paper Figure 2b heatmap palette.
scwat-blue-white-coral.note: Requires explicit meaningful center, range and normalization. Not the stronger red endpoint used in the refreshed inhibition case.

progeny-summary.source: Schubert et al., Nature Communications (2018), Figure 4c
progeny-summary.provenance: Selected PDF vector area fills rounded to 8-bit RGB, observed across inner summaries and colored density/pathway areas. Their selection/order and assignment to cohort IQR areas and new categories are EasyViz adaptations, not an author palette product.
progeny-summary.note: Intended for bounded summary areas with dark-neutral boundaries and observation marks. The pale mint is unsuitable as a habitual tiny-dot or thin-line color on white.

scwat-blue-pink.source: Huang et al., Nature Communications (2023), Figure 2g
scwat-blue-pink.provenance: The two actual fitted-line vector stroke RGB colors, rounded to 8-bit RGB. Assigning these stroke colors uniformly to new raw-point groups is an EasyViz adaptation; the source point paint layers are not all identical.
scwat-blue-pink.note: Compare actual two-class fixed-size observations on white. This pair does not authorize adding a fitted line or transferring the source biological labels.
